name: Local Media

required: The span value should be higher than 0

focusedTests: isolated application on all declared APK assets
combined application with every current optional patch
TV AVD playback of H.264 MKV with matching same-basename SRT
acceptance: Settings > Morphe > Playback contains a Local Media visibility section followed by one unsectioned shared Local storage path row at the bottom
The shared path is greyed and unfocusable while every installed storage feature is off and actionable when Local Media or Local Downloads is on
An existing playback.local_media.tree_uri value migrates once into the neutral shared playback.local_storage.path key

Show local storage in Library defaults on for a fresh preference without prompting at startup or toggle time; first entry into Library > Storage requests access when needed, denial leaves the setting on with a retry action, and stored choices persist
Library exposes Storage as a peer of Saved and Cloud without changing either native mode
Storage remains inside Nuvio's native Library screen and uses the same search, card, focus and file-picker visuals as Cloud
Storage shows STORAGE rather than NUVIO in the source badge
The Storage library lists direct files plus first-level folder cards with recursive playable-file counts and never lists subtitle files as videos

A valid segmented-media manifest appears as one logical video using its original filename, logical Library parent and combined size, while its mirrored physical bundle folder, part files and incomplete manifests remain hidden
Holding a Storage folder opens the one-option Delete Folder action popup during Android's native long-press interval and removes only that selected root folder after confirmation
Holding a Storage file opens the one-option Delete File action popup during the hold, removes its matching subtitle sidecars, and removes the containing root folder when no playable files remain

Deleting a segmented Storage item removes its complete manifest, every physical part and matching subtitle sidecars as one logical file; deleting a season removes both ordinary episode files and projected bundles and prunes empty folders
A same-basename SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, TTML or DFXP file is attached as a selectable Media3 subtitle track
Selecting a video opens Nuvio's existing internal player with the content URI and filename intact
Local playback completion and Back restore the existing Storage selection view without attempting catalogue metadata lookup
H.264 MKV video and audio play, seek and return normally from Movies/Nuvio
Changing the folder updates the in-place Storage library immediately and survives an app restart
Storage automatically rescans after Library is fully left and entered again, without requiring the Refresh action
Saved, Cloud, streaming playback and the separate Local Storage subtitle importer remain unchanged
No crash, ANR, VerifyError or fatal log occurs during folder selection, scan, playback, seeking, subtitle selection or exit
